description: Get email sending statistics (delivery, bounce, open, click, spam rates) for a date range. Optionally break down by domain, category, email service provider, or date.

breakdown.description: How to break down the stats: aggregated (default), by_domain, by_category, by_email_service_provider, or by_date

categories.description: Optional filter: limit to these email categories

email_service_providers.description: Optional filter: limit to these email service providers (e.g. Google, Yahoo, Outlook)

end_date.description: End date for the stats range (YYYY-MM-DD)

sending_domain_ids.description: Optional filter: limit to these sending domain IDs

sending_streams.description: Optional filter: limit to transactional and/or bulk stream

start_date.description: Start date for the stats range (YYYY-MM-DD)

name: get-sending-stats
